Title: Create dedicated GCP project for Meaning
Description: Set up a GCP project (e.g. meaning-data). Enable BigQuery API and IAM. This is the central project that will house all customer analytics data.

Title: Create BigQuery service account
Description: Create a service account with BigQuery Job User + BigQuery Data Viewer roles. Generate JSON key. Store securely and add GOOGLE_BIGQUERY_CREDENTIALS to env vars.

Title: Enable GA4 BigQuery export on test property
Description: Link a test GA4 property to BigQuery. Enable both daily export (events_YYYYMMDD) and streaming export (events_intraday_YYYYMMDD). Verify data appears within 24 hours.

Title: Define dataset naming convention and access strategy
Description: Decide on analytics_{property_id} dataset naming. Document whether datasets live in one project or customers link their own. Create a short ADR for the team.

Title: Validate raw export data against GA4 API
Description: Run the same query via GA4 Data API and a manual BigQuery SQL query. Compare results for sessions pageviews users traffic sources across a 7-day window. Document any discrepancies.

Title: Set up dbt project
Description: Initialize a dbt project (e.g. meaning-dbt) with BigQuery adapter. Configure connection using the service account. Add to the repo or a separate repo.

Title: Create staging model: stg_events
Description: Transform raw events_* tables: unnest event_params extract page_location source medium campaign normalize timestamps to UTC. Partition by date include property_id.

Title: Create mart model: sessions
Description: One row per session. Columns: session_id user_pseudo_id property_id session_start session_duration pageviews is_bounce landing_page exit_page source medium channel_group device_category country city.

Title: Create mart model: pageviews
Description: One row per pageview. Columns: event_timestamp user_pseudo_id session_id property_id page_path page_title page_referrer engagement_time_msec.

Title: Create mart model: users
Description: One row per user. Columns: user_pseudo_id property_id first_seen last_seen total_sessions total_pageviews acquisition_source acquisition_medium device_category country.

Title: Create mart model: conversions
Description: One row per conversion event. Columns: event_timestamp user_pseudo_id session_id property_id event_name conversion_value source medium.

Title: Create mart model: traffic_sources
Description: Pre-aggregated daily source/medium performance. Columns: date property_id source medium channel_group sessions users new_users pageviews bounce_rate avg_session_duration.

Title: Create mart model: realtime_active_users
Description: Query against events_intraday_* table. Active users in last 30 minutes with page country device breakdowns. Replaces runRealtimeReport.

Title: Configure incremental builds and scheduling
Description: Set dbt models to incremental (append new partitions daily). Set up a scheduled job (Cloud Scheduler + Cloud Run or dbt Cloud) to run dbt run daily. Full refresh weekly.

Title: Validate modeled data matches GA4 API output
Description: Compare mart outputs against equivalent GA4 Data API calls across all major report types (sessions traffic pages conversions geo device). Document and fix any gaps.

Title: Install @google-cloud/bigquery package
Description: Add the BigQuery Node.js client library to package.json. Verify it works in the Next.js server environment.

Title: Create src/lib/bigquery.ts
Description: New module that authenticates via service account and exposes: runQuery(sql params) getPropertySchema(propertyId) queryRealtimeData(propertyId). All queries must enforce property_id scoping.

Title: Define new BigQuery tool schemas in src/lib/tools.ts
Description: Replace GA4_TOOLS with BIGQUERY_TOOLS. Define query_analytics (structured params: metrics dimensions date range filters -> app generates SQL) get_realtime_data and get_available_fields.

Title: Update system prompt for BigQuery-backed tools
Description: Adjust the system prompt in chat route to describe the new data model (sessions pageviews users conversions traffic_sources tables) so Claude knows what is queryable.

Title: Update chat route tool execution
Description: In src/app/api/chat/route.ts replace GA4 tool execution with BigQuery tool execution. Remove dependency on user Google OAuth token for data queries.

Title: Update alert system for BigQuery
Description: Modify src/lib/alert-content.ts and src/app/api/alerts/send/route.ts to use BigQuery tools instead of GA4 tools. Remove getValidGoogleTokenForUser() dependency for data fetching.

Title: Add query cost guardrails
Description: Set maximumBytesBilled on every BigQuery query (e.g. 1 GB per query). Add LIMIT enforcement. Log query bytes billed for monitoring. Alert if a single customer exceeds a daily threshold.

Title: Update properties endpoint
Description: Modify src/app/api/analytics/properties/route.ts to return properties that have active BigQuery datasets not just GA4 API-accessible properties.

Title: Add DataSource model to Prisma schema
Description: New model: DataSource with fields id userId teamId type (enum: GA4_BIGQUERY) propertyId bigqueryDataset status (enum: PENDING ACTIVE ERROR) createdAt updatedAt. Run migration.

Title: Build BigQuery export status checker
Description: API endpoint or utility that checks whether a GA4 property has an active BigQuery link. Use the GA4 Admin API listBigQueryLinks method.

Title: Build onboarding UI for BigQuery export enablement
Description: After user selects a GA4 property show a step that checks if BQ export is enabled. If yes create DataSource record as ACTIVE. If no show instructions to enable it with a Check again button.

Title: Build data readiness check
Description: Background job or API that checks whether a PENDING DataSource has data in BigQuery yet (first events_* table exists). Flip status to ACTIVE when ready. Optionally notify user via email.

Title: Handle historical backfill (optional)
Description: For new customers optionally backfill the last 90 days of data from GA4 Data API into BigQuery so they don't start with an empty dataset. Create a one-time ETL job.

Title: Add usesBigQuery flag to property/data source
Description: Per-property boolean (on DataSource or a feature flag table) that controls which data path the chat route uses. Default false.

Title: Implement dual-path routing in chat route
Description: In chat route check the usesBigQuery flag. If true use BigQuery tools. If false use GA4 tools. Both paths produce the same response structure so the frontend is unaware.

Title: Implement dual-path routing in alert system
Description: Same as 5.2 but for alerts/send route and alert-content.ts.

Title: Enable BigQuery path on internal/test accounts
Description: Flip the flag for team accounts. Run all alert types and common chat queries. Validate charts scorecards and data accuracy against GA4 API responses.

Title: Parallel validation: compare outputs side-by-side
Description: For 2-4 weeks log both GA4 API and BigQuery responses for the same queries on test accounts. Build a comparison report. Fix any data model issues surfaced.

Title: Gradual rollout to customers
Description: Enable BigQuery path for customers who have active BigQuery export. Batch by cohort (10% then 50% then 100%). Monitor for errors and data accuracy issues.

Title: Deprecate GA4 API data path
Description: Remove GA4 API data-fetching code (src/lib/ga4.ts) old tool definitions and token refresh logic for data queries. Keep OAuth flow for onboarding only.

Title: Extend DataSource model for additional types
Description: Add enum values: STRIPE SEARCH_CONSOLE HUBSPOT etc. Add config JSON field for source-specific connection details.

Title: Build Google Search Console to BigQuery pipeline
Description: Enable Search Console BigQuery export (native) or build ETL. Create dbt models: search_queries search_pages. Add tools for Claude.

Title: Build Stripe/Paystack to BigQuery pipeline
Description: Use Stripe Sigma/Data Pipeline or a connector (Fivetran/Airbyte) to sync to BigQuery. Create dbt models: payments subscriptions revenue_daily. Add tools for Claude.

Title: Build cross-source mart models
Description: Models that join analytics + revenue + search data. E.g. page_performance joining pageviews + search impressions + conversion revenue per page.

Title: Update Claude tools for multi-source queries
Description: Extend tool definitions so Claude can query across sources. Update system prompt to describe available data sources per customer.

Title: Build data source management UI
Description: Settings page where customers connect/disconnect data sources see sync status and manage what is flowing into their BigQuery dataset.
